[[Category:Navarr Wayhouse]]
As a [[Navarr wayhouse]], {{{1}}} [[Navarr wayhouse#Support Navarr Characters|supports Navarr]] living in [[{{{2}}}]]. This means that the [[civil service]] can find Navarr characters a [[Resource#Personal_Resource|new resource]] in the territory for the normal cost; such resources do not suffer the [[Resource#Resources_in_other_Nations|usual problems]] with being established in a different nation; Navarr living here gain all the regular benefits provided by [[great work|great works]]; and they can participate in the [[Navarr leadership#Leading a territory|election]] of a specific Navarr [[senator]].
